description: The weekly digest for one topic (currently the topics with a digest, e.g. 'stablecoins', 'agentic-payments'): published news tagged with the topic or its sub-topics in one ISO week (Monday to Monday, Europe/Rome), newest first, plus the approved funding rounds linked to those stories. Amounts are never converted. Arguments: topic (required, topic slug), week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W45'; omit for the current week). Always returns available_weeks (last 12 weeks with at least one story). Unknown topic → error listing the digest topics. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W45'). Omit for the current week.

name: get_topic_digest
title: Get a weekly topic digest
